description: This file contains unit tests for the function SbPlayerGetAudioConfiguration, including test cases for different scenarios such as normal operation, no input, and multiple seeks. It uses Google Test framework and tests the behavior of audio configuration retrieval in a media player context.

classes.name: SbPlayerGetAudioConfigurationTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing SbPlayerGetAudioConfiguration, including methods to read and validate audio configurations.

methods.name: ReadAudioConfigurations
methods.description: Reads all available audio configurations from the player and stores them in a vector.

methods.name: AssertConfigurationIsValid
methods.description: Validates that a given SbMediaAudioConfiguration has valid connector and coding type values and non-negative channel count.
